description:
• About our brand and products: Our focus has been on making cannabis products easy to navigate and highly (no pun intended) accessible. We put intention into every product we make with the balance of science and nature, bringing cannabinoids together with function forward ingredients to help you Find Your Feel™ with something for everyone, from edibles to smokables.

• What makes us different: 
We exist to transform what is into what could be. Plant-based wellness is so much more than a list of ingredients. Using nature + science, we craft premium products that allow us to guide you toward an expected and wanted feeling — And because quality is of the utmost importance, we only source from ethical and organic farmers and producers. What truly excites us is the knowledge that high-quality cannabis can help people feel better and live better.

• How affiliates can earn:  Joining our affiliate program is simple — and rewarding. When you sign up, you’ll receive a unique referral link and coupon code to share with your audience. Each time someone makes a purchase through your link or uses your code, you earn a commission.

We track referrals automatically and keep everything transparent in your affiliate dashboard, so you can see clicks, sales, and earnings in real time. The more you share, the more you earn — it’s that easy.

• How to promote us: We make it easy for you to share our hemp products with your community. As an affiliate, you’ll have access to banners, product images, and ready-to-use links and coupon codes. Here are a few simple ways to spread the word:

    •    Social Media: Share your unique link or code in posts, reels, or stories.

    •    Content Creation: Write blog posts, reviews, or unboxings that highlight your favorite products.

    •    Email & Newsletters: Include your code when connecting with your subscribers or community.

    •    Word of Mouth: Recommend us directly to friends, family, and peers — every order through your code counts.

No matter how you promote, every click and purchase through your link or code adds to your commissions.
